title: Care for a little more AI?
author: Hugo Duminil-Copin

metaphors.title: Lighthouses in the night
metaphors.paraphrase: An open question is a lighthouse guiding mathematicians' wanderings; don't use our most beautiful conjectures as mere benchmarks.

metaphors.title: Bulldozers, battering rams, nukes
metaphors.paraphrase: Conjectures fall to bulldozers and battering rams; AI discoveries decapitate fields and nuke the landscape.
